verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents separate tools that resemble each view type: Card Tables (kanban boards), to-do lists, a global calendar, and a timeline-style overview of overlaps and key dates. Nothing in the evidence shows these are switchable views of the same underlying work items. Distinct tools holding different data are adjacent features, not the view-switching capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
